behaviors.description: Assert the public AppStream refresh callback contract.
behaviors.preconditions: Uncached AppStream over deliberately delayed HTTP payloads; a distinct pushed thread-default context and live user-data sentinel.
behaviors.expected: At least one callback uses exact supplied data on the caller thread while owning its selected context, with displayable status and bounded percentage. Estimating and final progress are recorded without prescribing values. No callbacks occur in the post-return observation window or during a later callback-free refresh; refreshed XML matches reference export.
notes: GLib permits direct invocation while the selected context is owned even with a different thread-default context pushed. Because pushing acquires ownership, this verifies execution conditions, not a particular dispatch mechanism.

behaviors.description: Resolve contrasting download/delete policies from declared extensions.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent policy repository; empty installation; Automatic declares no-autodownload=false/autodelete=false and Optional declares both true.
behaviors.expected: Exactly both extension identities and fixture commits; should_download/should_delete are true/false for Automatic and false/true for Optional; fetched main metadata matches independent exported declarations.

behaviors.description: Refresh a remote's AppStream cache and inspect its public location.
behaviors.preconditions: Prepared repository contains independently exported native AppStream XML; cache initially absent.
behaviors.expected: First refresh changes content; repeat does not; remote AppStream directory contains XML equivalent to the prepared repository snapshot.

behaviors.description: Identify the controlled sandbox's application process and supervising parent.
behaviors.preconditions: DO_NOT_REAP launches held alive until explicit release; public procfs exposes process executable and ancestry.
behaviors.expected: Child PID becomes positive and executable bytes match the deployed probe; process ancestry reaches outer PID; child watch confirms successful exit.

behaviors.description: Calculate unused dependencies under hypothetical app state.
behaviors.preconditions: App and its automatically installed unpinned runtime, with no initially unused refs.
behaviors.expected: Excluding the app or injecting an absent runtime/SDK makes exactly the original runtime unused; actual app metadata and both commits remain unchanged; subsequent ordinary query is empty.

behaviors.description: Launch selected installed builds through libflatpak and enumerate live instances.
behaviors.preconditions: Two controlled probe apps copy their internal flatpak-info and remain alive until the client releases them.
behaviors.expected: Direct launch succeeds twice; both report version A; distinct enumerated IDs, full app/runtime identities and snapshot-matching info while alive.
references: common/flatpak-instance.c: public enumeration and identity getters

behaviors.description: Track launched instances with caller-owned child watches.
behaviors.preconditions: Two DO_NOT_REAP launches return instances; probes hold lifetime until explicit release.
behaviors.expected: Returned instances have exact live identities and info; watches observe successful exit; retained instances then report not running.

behaviors.description: Fetch and enumerate with ONLY_CACHED.
behaviors.preconditions: Controlled HTTP repository, first absent cache then populated A cache with server advertising B.
behaviors.expected: Absent cache returns NOT_CACHED; populated cache yields exact A identity/membership; neither query phase performs any HTTP request.

behaviors.description: Distinguish available and locally installed related refs.
behaviors.preconditions: App declares optional extension; extension initially absent, then installed from another remote.
behaviors.expected: Remote list has exact extension and commit; installed list starts empty then includes extension installed from other remote; policy and full-subpath values asserted.

behaviors.description: Resolve related branches against the installed app version.
behaviors.preconditions: Installed A requests test extension; remote B requests next extension.
behaviors.expected: Remote query returns next; for-installed query returns test, each with controlled commit and policy values.

behaviors.description: Enumerate remotely available and downloaded undeployed updates.
behaviors.preconditions: App A and runtime current, then remote B, then B downloaded without deployment, then B deployed.
behaviors.expected: Exact empty/app/app/empty sets; unchanged runtime excluded throughout.

behaviors.description: Configure a ref-file remote without deploying its app.
behaviors.preconditions: Initially empty installation and valid literal flatpakref pointing at controlled repository.
behaviors.expected: Returned ref has exact identity and NULL commit; its remote exists at expected URL; installed list remains empty.

behaviors.description: Enumerate installed membership and kind filters.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent query repository; initially empty, then runtime only, then three app builds.
behaviors.expected: Exact unordered installed sets and both empty-kind cases; advertised undeployed refs excluded.

behaviors.description: Select default and current app branches.
behaviors.preconditions: Direct installation of master followed by test, with runtime already installed.
behaviors.expected: NULL components select master; current app is the last directly installed test commit and reports current TRUE.

behaviors.description: Read deployed metadata, location, origin and size.
behaviors.preconditions: App exported by reference tooling, expected exact metadata and size recorded before target execution.
behaviors.expected: Byte-exact metadata with runtime and permissions; origin queries; deployment directory holds matching metadata and fixture payload; size matches exported commit.

behaviors.description: Load embedded appdata from an installed app.
behaviors.preconditions: Prepared compressed AppStream and controlled C locale.
behaviors.expected: Decompressed XML has exactly the fixture elements, attributes and text, ignoring formatting whitespace; name and summary equal literal fields.

behaviors.description: Retain an installed ref after its installation is released.
behaviors.preconditions: Actual deployed fixture queried through a separate installation object.
behaviors.expected: Retained ref identity and commit remain equal to the fixture after source destruction.

behaviors.description: Read full and partial deployment subpaths.
behaviors.preconditions: One full app and another directly installed with /bin only.
behaviors.expected: Full getter is NULL; partial getter has exactly /bin and terminator.

behaviors.description: List available refs by remote name and URI.
behaviors.preconditions: No refs installed; prepared multi-ref repository.
behaviors.expected: Both sources return the exact advertised native-architecture ref set.

behaviors.description: Include a foreign-architecture ref in remote enumeration.
behaviors.preconditions: Prepared repository includes an app for an architecture outside host primary architectures.
behaviors.expected: ALL_ARCHES returns exact complete advertised set including the foreign app.

behaviors.description: Compare remote cached and direct metadata and sizes.
behaviors.preconditions: Expected bytes and integer sizes from independently exported commit metadata.
behaviors.expected: Cached getters and direct queries match every expected value.

behaviors.description: Query remote B while A remains deployed.
behaviors.preconditions: Installed A; same remote changed to independent B repository.
behaviors.expected: Remote ref commit B and origin queries; installed lookup still returns A.

behaviors.description: Read real bundle payloads and retain owned results.
behaviors.preconditions: Reference-exported bundles with and without URLs, distinct 64/128 PNGs, compressed XML and metadata.
behaviors.expected: Identity, commit, file, metadata, XML, size, icons and URLs match; owned file, bytes and origin survive bundle destruction.

behaviors.description: Install, update and uninstall through deprecated direct APIs.
behaviors.preconditions: Runtime satisfied; independent repositories A then B.
behaviors.expected: Direct install returns deployed A, direct update returns deployed B, direct uninstall leaves NOT_INSTALLED.

behaviors.description: Distinguish direct no-op and absent updates.
behaviors.preconditions: Current app and a separate absent advertised app.
behaviors.expected: update_full returns NULL with Flatpak ALREADY_INSTALLED or NOT_INSTALLED respectively.

behaviors.description: Pull without deployment, then deploy the pulled ref.
behaviors.preconditions: Runtime satisfied and app initially absent.
behaviors.expected: NO_DEPLOY returns ONLY_PULLED and leaves app absent; NO_PULL returns fixture commit and deploys it.

mappings.rationale: C assertions require a callback and check exact user data, active call scope, caller thread, ownership of the originally selected context, display status and percentage range. Estimating accepts gboolean zero/nonzero semantics and is recorded, as are final progress values. Post-return context iteration and a subsequent callback-free refresh check bounded call scope. Delayed payload observation and independent XML verify real refresh work. Context ownership is an execution condition, not proof of main-loop dispatch; nested thread-default contexts are permitted.

Real reference-exported extension declarations produce opposite download/delete results on public related-ref enumeration; exact membership, commits, absent installed state and fetched declaration bytes are asserted without fabricated result properties.
TRUE first refresh and FALSE unchanged repeat; compressed XML at public remote cache directory compared against independent reference-exported AppStream.
exclude-refs and metadata injection independently produce exact dependency changes without modifying deployed app/runtime identity or app metadata.
Direct library launches synchronize on two real sandbox probes; independently expected commits and identities, distinct enumeration IDs and every sandbox snapshot key are asserted.
DO_NOT_REAP returns exact fixture instances; explicit probe release, successful child watches and post-exit FALSE liveness checked on retained instances.
Synchronized child PID must identify the deployed probe executable; its ancestry must reach the outer PID; caller child watch confirms exit.
Both full APIs assert exact NOT_CACHED errors without HTTP on fresh cache and exact stale A results without HTTP after priming.
Actual declared extension and empty-before/one-after installed lists include extension deployed from another remote.
Divergent app metadata produces exact next remote result and test for-installed result with fixture commits.
Four states assert exact update membership including downloaded undeployed B and exclusion of current dependency-complete refs.
Direct ref-file API returns NULL-commit ref, configures a lookup-visible expected remote URL and leaves installation empty.
Exact unordered sets across empty, runtime-only and multi-app states exclude undeployed available refs.
Direct installs select distinct branches; default lookup commit and last-installed current identity/flag asserted.
Expected exported metadata bytes and exact size, literal origin and real payload at reported deployment directory asserted.
Full decompressed XML structure, attributes, text and literal name/summary checked on a deployed reference-exported app.
Fresh source installation released before independently owned returned ref identity/commit assertions.
Actual full and partial deployments expose NULL and exact single-element subpaths respectively.
Both configured name and URI yield exact native app/runtime ref membership while none is installed.
Exact complete ALL_ARCHES membership includes independently exported foreign architecture.
Cached and direct byte results and both size integers match values recorded during independent preparation.
Remote identity/origin/B commit checked alongside still-deployed distinct A commit.
Actual bundles assert all payload fields against independent inputs, both optional URL cases and retained transfer-full results after destruction.
All three deprecated functions execute; returned and queried commits match A/B and final lookup yields NOT_INSTALLED.
update_full NULL and exact public domain/code asserted for current and absent fixtures.
NO_DEPLOY exact ONLY_PULLED plus absent deployment, then NO_PULL exact deployed commit.
